Hi Samir —

Thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the integration snag. We can do either path; a couple of notes and tradeoffs so you can pick:

- 3-week extension: we can add a timebox extension and keep the current pilot SKU unchanged. This preserves test continuity but requires an amendment (no additional discount by default).
- Credit conversion: we can convert unused days into a token bucket (redeemable within 60 days). We typically price this at ~70% of list to reflect the operational cost; that ends up being more credit-efficient if you can convert immediately into more inference runs.
- SKU-flex option: if you plan to scale to a larger throughput during the extension window, we can offer a phased SKU swap (temporary burst SKUs) and a small conversion credit for unused reservation days.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm the numbers and whether we can add a short-term conversion discount? Samir, if you can share an estimate of remaining token/day needs or whether you want pure time, we’ll draft the amendment.

Best,

Irene / Ben — quick pricing note for Cartesian:

- 3-week timebox extension (same SKU): no discount, fee = prorated daily at $2,400/day -> ~$50,400 for 21 days.
- Credit conversion: convert remaining 18 unused pilot days -> token credit equal to 60% of equivalent prepaid list => credit value: $30,240.
- SKU-flex (phased burst): temporary burst SKU adds $900/day on top of base; if they convert unused days to credits we can bump conversion to 70% to incent conversion.
